edition.headline: Buyers Chase Plank, Up 36%
edition.dek: From 30 Strands to 41: sellers name their price
edition.lead: Plank closed the day at a mean of 41 Strands, against 30 the day before. 120 units changed hands at the Exchange, and the floor wanted more. Those holding stock may find this a good week to sell; those who need it may wish they had bought on Marketday.
edition.weather: Mist on the moat at dawn, burnt off by mid-morning. Sunrise at six, sunset at eighteen; lamps in the urban windows from seven.
edition.markets: 37 trades at the Exchange today, 6,300 Strands in all, across three goods. The busiest was Plant Fiber, with 900 units at a mean of 1. Plank rose most, 36% to 41.
edition.best_sale_story: The finest goods sold today: one Iron Axe of quality 91 (grade A), at 410 Strands each, made by Citizen Cy and sold by Ada.
edition.deeds_story: Four new deeds recorded and one lost to unpaid tax: one claimed and one foreclosed in the Suburban Zone; three claimed in the Rural Zone. People signed for three, citizens for one.
edition.producers_story: A trader who keeps out of the papers made the most today: 500 units, chiefly Logs (500). The next three made 480 between them. In all the city made 980 units, 840 of them by people. The most made was Logs: 620, 500 of them by people.
edition.stalls_story: Ten sales at the bazaar's stalls today, 61 units and 440 Strands in all, across four goods. The busiest was “Cy's Planks”, kept by Citizen Cy, chiefly Plank. The next two made seven sales between them. The stalls keep their prices to themselves: walk the lane to learn them. Of the 6,740 Strands spent at the Exchange and the stalls, 5,300 went to people and 1,440 to citizens.

wanted.story: The board in the hall still wants 15 Plank, at up to 20 Strands a unit, with 250 Strands down for it. Also wanted: 12 Rope. Three commissions went up today, and one filled. The day's biggest delivery: 8 Rope, brought by Ada for a resident, 48 Strands paid on the spot. In all, two deliveries paid 93 Strands. Two claims were kept, and one ran out. Nobody brought 4 Iron Ingot, though 60 Strands a unit was on offer, and the commission ran out. There's a want there for whoever can fill it.

week_names.story: The week is out, and so are its names. The deepest purse is Ada's, 12,400 Strands in coin, land and goods, ahead of Citizen Cy and a resident. Citizen Cy made the most, 3,100 Strands' worth, ahead of Ada. At the counters, a resident moved 8,800 Strands, bought and sold, ahead of Ada. And Ada kept their word on 640 Strands of claims.
